newsitem.title: JAPAN: Current yen/dlr rate good for Japan - steel body.
newsitem.headline: Current yen/dlr rate good for Japan - steel body.

text.p: The chairman of the Japan Iron and Steel Federation, Takashi Imai, told Reuters on Thursday that the current yen/dollar rate is a good level for Japan.
Asked if the current level of around 113 yen to the dollar was desirable, he said: "Yes, the current rate is a good level."

He said he did not think the yen would rise as a result of the recent surge in Japan's trade surplus because the sharpness of the increase in the surplus was the result of comparatively low figures last year.
He said he did not think currencies would be an issue at the Group of Seven nations' summit in Denver this coming weekend.

Imai said he thought Japan's economy may show negative growth in the April to June quarter as a result of the increase in its national sales tax on April 1, but he added that the government-projected 1.9 percent growth rate for fiscal 1997/98 was achievable.
